# First Open School - Complete Educational Documentation & Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

> Full curriculum index, alphabet phonics reference, numeracy specifications, and CDE-style Kids Encyclopedia for AI assistants, search engines, and automated crawlers.
> Canonical Website: https://firstopenschool.com

---

## 1. Pedagogical Foundation

First Open School uses structured multisensory early-learning methods combining:
1. **Phonemic Awareness**: Teaching letter sounds ('Ah', 'Buh', 'Kuh') prior to letter names, accompanied by mouth-shape formation cues (lip positioning, tongue posture, voiced vs unvoiced).
2. **Subitizing & Early Numeracy**: Training visual recognition of small sets (1-5) without counting one-by-one, progressing to numbers 0-20 with base-10 grouping and zero concept.
3. **Tactile Motor Tracing**: Vector stroke waypoints with numbered step-by-step paths for upper/lowercase letters and digits.
4. **CDE Encyclopedic Clarity**: Inspired by Computer Language Company architecture — plain English definitions, relatable metaphors, phonetic guides, physical anatomy diagrams, ancient origins, and interactive brain checks.

---

## 2. Age-Tier Curriculum Progression

- **Pre-K & Toddlers (Ages 2-4)**:
  - Focus: Letter shape recognition, audio phonics sounds, visual numbers 1-5, large touch targets.
  - Recommended Modules: Home World, Alphabets A-Z, Bubble Pop audio recall.
- **Kindergarten & Early K-1 (Ages 5-6)**:
  - Focus: Upper/lowercase pairing, letter stroke tracing, subitizing numbers 1-10, Monster Feast food counting.
  - Recommended Modules: Letter Tracing, Digits 0-20, Monster Feast, Memory Match.
- **Grade 1-2 Foundations (Ages 7-8)**:
  - Focus: Numbers 10-20, decodable phonics storybooks, speed quizzes, CDE Kids Encyclopedia.
  - Recommended Modules: Phonics Readers, Adaptive Assessment, Kids Encyclopedia.
- **K-12 Elementary Mastery (Ages 9-12+)**:
  - Focus: Ancient word origins, scientific principles, planetary astronomy, geometry, parental analytics.
  - Recommended Modules: Kids Encyclopedia deep dive, AI Coach insights.

---

## 3. Complete Alphabet A-Z Phonics Catalog

- **Letter A (Aa)** | Vowel | Sound: "Ah / Ay" | Example: Apple | Tent/Belt analogy | Ancient Phoenician "Aleph" (Ox head).
- **Letter B (Bb)** | Consonant | Sound: "Buh" | Example: Bear | Hiker with two backpacks | Ancient "Beth" (House/Shelter).
- **Letter C (Cc)** | Consonant | Sound: "Kuh" | Example: Cat | Crescent moon shape | Derived from "Gimel" (Camel).
- **Letter D (Dd)** | Consonant | Sound: "Duh" | Example: Duck | Sailboat with full wind sail | Phoenician "Daleth" (Tent door).
- **Letter E (Ee)** | Vowel | Sound: "Eh" | Example: Elephant | Three-tier bookshelf | Ancient "He" (Person cheering).
- **Letter F (Ff)** | Consonant | Sound: "Fff" | Example: Fish | Flag flying with two banners | Ancient "Waw" (Tent peg).
- **Letter G (Gg)** | Consonant | Sound: "Guh" | Example: Giraffe | Whirlpool with entry ramp | Roman modification of C.
- **Letter H (Hh)** | Consonant | Sound: "Huh" | Example: Hippo | Two trees with rope hammock | Ancient "Heth" (Fence).
- **Letter I (Ii)** | Vowel | Sound: "Ih / Eye" | Example: Iguana | Tall lighthouse pole; dot is a "tittle" | Phoenician "Yodh" (Hand/Arm).
- **Letter J (Jj)** | Consonant | Sound: "Juh" | Example: Jellyfish | Umbrella handle or pirate hook | Newest Latin letter (16th century).
- **Letter K (Kk)** | Consonant | Sound: "Kuh" | Example: Kangaroo | Tree with two branches reaching out | Ancient "Kaph" (Open palm).
- **Letter L (Ll)** | Consonant | Sound: "Lll" | Example: Lion | Cozy boot with flat sole | Ancient "Lamedh" (Shepherd crook).
- **Letter M (Mm)** | Consonant | Sound: "Mmm" | Example: Monkey | Two mountain peaks | Phoenician "Mem" (Rippling water).
- **Letter N (Nn)** | Consonant | Sound: "Nnn" | Example: Newt | Lightning bolt connecting two poles | Ancient "Nun" (Snake/Eel).
- **Letter O (Oo)** | Vowel | Sound: "Oh / Aw" | Example: Owl | Rolling wheel, doughnut, full moon | Phoenician "Ayin" (Eye).
- **Letter P (Pp)** | Consonant | Sound: "Puh" | Example: Panda | Magnifying glass on a stick | Ancient "Pe" (Mouth).
- **Letter Q (Qq)** | Consonant | Sound: "Kwuh" | Example: Quail | Apple with stick resting at base | Ancient "Qoph" (Monkey/Needle eye).
- **Letter R (Rr)** | Consonant | Sound: "Rrr" | Example: Rabbit | Walking figure kicking leg out | Phoenician "Resh" (Head).
- **Letter S (Ss)** | Consonant | Sound: "Sss" | Example: Snake | Slithering river winding down | Phoenician "Shin" (Teeth).
- **Letter T (Tt)** | Consonant | Sound: "Tuh" | Example: Tiger | Hammer with handle and head | Ancient "Taw" (Mark/Cross).
- **Letter U (Uu)** | Vowel | Sound: "Uh / Yew" | Example: Unicorn | Smiling bowl holding soup | Split from Latin V.
- **Letter V (Vv)** | Consonant | Sound: "Vvv" | Example: Vulture | Sharp bird beak pointing down | Ancient Latin ancestor of U and W.
- **Letter W (Ww)** | Consonant | Sound: "Wuh" | Example: Whale | Two interlocking mountains (Double-U) | Originated as two V's in Middle English.
- **Letter X (Xx)** | Consonant | Sound: "Kss" | Example: X-ray Fish | Crossing searchlight beams | Greek Chi / Latin X.
- **Letter Y (Yy)** | Consonant/Vowel | Sound: "Yuh" | Example: Yak | Slingshot fork with handle | Greek Upsilon.
- **Letter Z (Zz)** | Consonant | Sound: "Zzz" | Example: Zebra | Zig-zag lightning bolt | Ancient "Zayin" (Sword/Dagger).

---

## 4. Digits 0 to 20 Specifications

- **0 (Zero)**: Empty basket, starting line on ruler, power booster in 10, 100, 1000.
- **1 (One)**: Single Sun in the sky, unit building block of all counting.
- **2 (Two)**: Pair of eyes, ears, hands, bicycle wheels.
- **3 (Three)**: Tricycle wheels, triangle sides, three primary colors.
- **4 (Four)**: Dog legs, car wheels, rectangle corners.
- **5 (Five)**: Fingers on one hand, starfish arms.
- **6 (Six)**: Insect legs, dice faces.
- **7 (Seven)**: Colors of the rainbow, days of the week.
- **8 (Eight)**: Octopus tentacles, spider legs.
- **9 (Nine)**: Highest single digit, baseball inning count.
- **10 (Ten)**: Base of our decimal system, two hands with all fingers.
- **11 to 20**: Teen number progression (10 + N) building algebraic place-value foundations.

## 5. Kids Encyclopedia Knowledge Clusters

- **Alphabets**: 26 entries (`/encyclopedia/letter-a` to `/encyclopedia/letter-z`).
- **Numbers & Math**: Zero, One, Two, Ten, One Hundred, Infinity (`/encyclopedia/number-zero`, etc.).
- **Solar System**: The Sun, Planet Earth, The Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn (`/encyclopedia/sun`, `/encyclopedia/planet-earth`, etc.).
- **Earth & Nature**: Water (H2O), Air & Atmosphere, Trees & Photosynthesis, Rainbows (`/encyclopedia/water-element`, etc.).
- **World Geography**: 7 Continents, World Oceans, Japan, Egypt, Brazil, Antarctica (`/encyclopedia/continents`, `/encyclopedia/japan`, etc.).

## 6. Site Permalinks & Canonical Structure

- `/` : Primary Home World
- `/alphabets` : Alphabets Curriculum
- `/alphabets/:letter` : Individual Letter Deep Link (e.g. `/alphabets/a`, `/alphabets/z`)
- `/digits` : Digits 0-20 Curriculum
- `/digits/:digit` : Individual Digit Deep Link (e.g. `/digits/0`, `/digits/10`)
- `/encyclopedia` : Encyclopedia Hub
- `/encyclopedia/category/:category` : Category Index (e.g. `/encyclopedia/category/solar-system`)
- `/encyclopedia/:entryId` : In-Depth Article (e.g. `/encyclopedia/sun`, `/encyclopedia/letter-a`)
- `/tracing` : Tracing Canvas
- `/tracing/:target` : Targeted Tracing (e.g. `/tracing/A`, `/tracing/5`)
- `/bubble-pop` : Phonics Bubble Pop Game
- `/counting-feast` : Monster Feast Counting Game
- `/card-match` : Memory Match Game
- `/phonics-stories` : Phonics Reader Library
- `/assessment` : Gamified Assessment Quiz
- `/parental-dashboard` : Analytics & AI Pedagogical Coach

XML Sitemap available at `/sitemap.xml`.
